facilities.name: War Factory
facilities.blurb: The workhorse. Wheeled and tracked ground units, plus the support trucks the new Resupply rules need.
facilities.overlap: existing: recon, tank, heavy tank, artillery, flak

facilities.name: Hover Lab
facilities.blurb: Anti-gravity craft that float over land, shoals and sea alike. Fast and flexible, thinly armoured, and they overlap with the War Factory, the Shipyard and the Airfield.

facilities.name: Mech Factory
facilities.blurb: Legged walkers. Slow, tough and unfazed by terrain: they climb mountains that stop every wheel and tread.

facilities.name: Stealth Lab
facilities.blurb: Cloaked variants of ordinary roles. Invisible unless an enemy ends a move next to them, which makes scouting and sonar-style detection matter on land and in the air.

facilities.name: Training Ground
facilities.blurb: Specialist infantry: healers, engineers, heavy-weapon troopers and a cheap draftee. They fill the gaps between the soldier, the mech and the sniper, and make the front line sustainable.

facilities.name: Engineer Works
facilities.blurb: Builds immobile static defences that are placed next to your property and cannot move (move 0). Cheap to hold ground with, impossible to reposition.

facilities.name: Airfield (new aircraft)
facilities.blurb: New aircraft for the existing Airfield: a stealth interceptor, a ship-killing torpedo plane, an airborne radar, and cheap wartime-era fighters and bombers.
facilities.overlap: existing: transport copter, copter, fighter, bomber

facilities.name: Shipyard (new ships)
facilities.blurb: New hulls for the existing Shipyard: a floating airstrip, a nimble patrol boat and the heaviest gun platform afloat.

facilities.name: Glider Field
facilities.blurb: Cheap, silent, unpowered aircraft. No fuel, no engine, one way trips: they trade range and survivability for price.

facilities.name: Space Port
facilities.blurb: Orbital and re-entry hardware. Very expensive and very fast; the satellite is the only unit that can strike without ever being in reach.

facilities.name: Underwater Lab
facilities.blurb: Deep-sea hardware built on the coast: deeper divers than the submarine, sea mines, and expendable torpedo drones.

facilities.name: Drone Bay
facilities.blurb: Small unmanned aircraft. Individually weak, they win by numbers, sight and by keeping everyone else fighting.

facilities.name: Salvage Yard
facilities.blurb: Lastholm's workshop: Harlan's volunteers bolt guns onto whatever still runs. Cheap, battered machines, and the only factory the Chorus cannot switch off because nothing in it runs on Gift tech.

units.name: Hover Scout
units.mechanic: The fastest ground-level unit. Crosses land, shoals and sea at the same cost, sees 2 tiles further than other ground units, but any hit hurts.

units.name: Hover Carrier
units.mechanic: Carries one foot unit across water and land. The passenger unloads from the bow ramp after the carrier moves, like a Deploy that does not use ammo.

units.name: Strider
units.mechanic: A bipedal walker with a cannon port on one arm. Treats mountains and forest like plain ground (move cost 1) but is weaker against tank rounds than a tread.

units.name: Titan
units.mechanic: Cannon ports on both arms and the most hit points in the game. Walks over woods and mountains and flattens forest it crosses into plain ground.

units.name: Rocket Walker
units.mechanic: A slim walker with a rocket pod mounted on its shoulder. Fires over a short ring (range 2-3) but not after moving, and climbs terrain like the other walkers. Lightly armoured.

units.name: Scout Walker
units.mechanic: A small, quick walker on thin legs. Sees one tile further than other ground units and crosses mountains and forest at plain cost. Carries one light gun port (range 1) and any real hit hurts.

units.name: Flame Walker
units.mechanic: A flamer port on one arm and a fuel tank on its back. Range 1 only, devastating against infantry and units in cover, weak against tanks. Flame attacks allow no counterattack. Its fuel tank makes it volatile: when destroyed it explodes, hurting adjacent units.

units.name: Bulwark
units.mechanic: A walker behind a shield plate. Takes much less damage from ranged attacks and strikes at range 1 with a piston fist. Slow, and the shield does nothing against bombs from above.

units.name: Troop Glider
units.mechanic: Carries one soldier. Costs very little, but after unloading it is consumed. No ammo and no fuel, and it can only land on open ground.

units.name: Scout Glider
units.mechanic: A hang glider with a pilot. Almost free, sees 4 tiles, unarmed. Falls out of the sky if anything at all hits it.

units.name: Drop Pod
units.mechanic: Launched, not driven: lands on any visible tile within 8 tiles of a friendly property, arrives with a Mech aboard, then the pod stays as a bunker (1 hit point more defence).

units.name: Shuttle
units.mechanic: Moves 12 and carries two foot units. Flies above fighters' reach: only flak can hit it, at half damage.

units.name: Orbital Satellite
units.mechanic: Placed on the board edge. Every third turn its laser can hit any tile in view of your units, for heavy damage. Cannot be attacked except by another satellite.

units.name: Abyss Sub
units.mechanic: Dives to a deeper layer than a submarine: sonar sees it only when adjacent. Slower, but its heavy torpedo outranges destroyers.

units.name: Torpedo Drone
units.mechanic: Cheap and fast; one attack, then it is destroyed. Cannot be built unless you already own a Mine Layer or Abyss Sub.

units.name: Swarm Drones
units.mechanic: A pack of small drones: hits hard against infantry, little against armour. Weakens as its strength drops, since each drone lost is a quarter of the unit.

units.name: Repair Drone
units.mechanic: Repairs 2 hit points on every friendly unit next to it at the start of your turn, for 10% of the unit's price per point. Fights back with a weak wrench (range 1) that ignores armor completely.

units.name: Gun Turret
units.mechanic: A light machine-gun pillbox with range 1-2 that fires at anything on the ground, best against infantry and weak against vehicles (low damage to tanks). It cannot move and has modest armour.

units.name: Automated Factory
units.mechanic: Every other turn it spawns a free light robot (a weak walker that cannot capture) on a free adjacent tile, up to 3 alive at once. Immobile and unarmed; it has the toughness of a tank and can be destroyed, or captured by infantry like a normal building.

units.name: Land Mine
units.mechanic: One mine is placed per use. The first ground unit to enter the tile takes about 50% damage and the mine is spent. Invisible to the enemy unless one of their units is adjacent; engineers and mechanics can clear it safely.

units.name: Training Ground
units.mechanic: Builds specialist infantry: commando, RPG trooper, mechanic, medic, mortar team, conscript, spy, diver, motorcycle.

units.name: Hover Lab
units.mechanic: Builds the anti-gravity craft: hover scout, hover tank and hover carrier.

units.name: Mech Factory
units.mechanic: Builds the legged walkers: strider and titan.

units.name: Stealth Lab
units.mechanic: Builds the cloaked units: stealth tank and stealth copter.

units.name: Glider Field
units.mechanic: Builds the cheap unpowered aircraft: troop glider and scout glider.

units.name: Space Port
units.mechanic: Builds orbital hardware: drop pod, shuttle and the orbital satellite.

units.name: Drone Bay
units.mechanic: Builds the small unmanned aircraft: swarm drones and repair drones.

units.name: Engineer Works
units.mechanic: Builds the static defences: turrets, SAM turrets, artillery turrets, jammers, mines and walls.

units.name: Underwater Lab
units.mechanic: A coastal base standing in the shallows. Builds the abyss sub, mine layer and torpedo drones.

units.name: Radar Station
units.mechanic: A support base with a large vision radius: it sees units hidden by fog from many tiles away. Cannot build or attack.

units.name: Supply Depot
units.mechanic: A support base that resupplies and slowly repairs every friendly unit next to it, whatever its type. Cannot build or attack.

units.name: Bunker
units.mechanic: A fortified property: a unit inside takes much less damage. Holds one unit, cannot build.

units.name: Engineer
units.mechanic: NEW MECHANIC, building in the field: instead of attacking, builds a wall, a tank trap or a static defence on an adjacent empty tile (paid for, ready next turn), repairs a cracked wall into a whole one, or knocks down an adjacent cracked wall. Lets walls and defences appear mid-mission instead of only from the map. Weak rifle, can capture.

units.name: Flame Trooper
units.mechanic: Range 1. Flame attacks allow no counterattack: whatever it burns cannot hit back. Its damage ignores the target's terrain defence (fire goes round sandbags), and an attack on a forest burns it to plains for the rest of the battle, taking away the sniper's and the soldier's cover. When it is destroyed its tanks burst and deal 1 damage to every adjacent unit, friend or foe.

units.name: Royal Guard
units.mechanic: Armoured infantry (armour 0.4: rifles and other weapons without armour piercing do 40% less) with a simple rifle (the soldier's, range 1). NEW MECHANIC, guarding: friendly infantry next to it take 30% less damage from direct fire. A moving shield wall for pushing soldiers across open plains, and able to shoot back. Armour-piercing weapons (RPG, bazooka, Tesla cannon) ignore its plating. Cannot capture.

units.name: K9 Team
units.mechanic: Infantry with a dog: move 3 on foot, and it smells out cloaked ground units (spy, sniper in a forest, stealth tank, a diver coming ashore) within 2 tiles, revealing them to the whole team. The cheap counter to Vex's stealth kit. Weak bite at range 1.

units.name: Shock Trooper
units.mechanic: Hand-held Tesla cannon: range 1-2, damage 40, the lightning ignores armour completely and the cannon never runs out of charge, but the arc is weaker than a rifle's and the Shock Trooper is as fragile as a soldier. Can move and fire. A cheap, endless answer to Royal Guards and heavy armour, best kept behind the front line. Cannot capture.

units.name: Fanatic
units.mechanic: A cheap AK-47 (range 1, as strong as a soldier's rifle). Explodes when it dies, however it dies (shot, countered, even burned): the blast deals 3 damage to every adjacent unit, friend or foe, and sets off any neighbouring Fanatic it kills. Punishes whoever kills it from next to it, and makes the enemy think twice about attacking it. Can capture.

units.name: Bridge Layer
units.mechanic: NEW MECHANIC, terrain building: unfolds its bridge over one adjacent river or shoal tile, turning it into a bridge that anyone can use (the enemy too) until it is destroyed. Opens a second crossing on river maps and makes chokepoints a choice, not a fact of the map. Unarmed.

units.name: Inflatable Decoy
units.mechanic: NEW MECHANIC, disguise: the enemy sees it as a real tank (name, icon, HP) until it is attacked or an enemy unit ends its move next to it. The first hit pops it. The AI should fall for it: it draws artillery fire and makes a thin line look strong. Vex's kind of unit.

units.name: Smoke Carrier
units.mechanic: NEW MECHANIC, smoke: fires smoke at a tile 2 to 4 away; it and the tiles round it are fogged until the end of the enemy's next turn. Units inside cannot be targeted by indirect fire or seen from outside, and cannot see out themselves. Covers an advance or a retreat; useless as a weapon.

units.name: EMP Truck
units.mechanic: NEW MECHANIC, stun: once per battle (ammo 1, refilled at a factory), it pulses: every vehicle, aircraft and static defence within 1 tile, friend or foe, cannot move or fire on its owner's next turn. Infantry are unaffected. In the campaign it hits Chorus units harder: an assimilated unit caught in the pulse also loses 2 HP.

units.name: Tank Destroyer
units.mechanic: A tank with no turret: hits tanks harder than a heavy tank does, but it can only fire if it has not moved this turn (like artillery, at range 1). Strong in a prepared position, poor on the attack. A sideways choice to the tank rather than a bigger one.

units.name: Technical
units.mechanic: A pickup with a machine gun bolted in the back: cheaper and faster than a recon, but with half its armour. Harlan's opening unit: a lot of them early, before the heavy kit arrives.

units.name: Salvager
units.mechanic: NEW MECHANIC, wrecks: in a battle with a Salvager, a destroyed vehicle, ship or aircraft leaves a wreck on its tile (it costs 1 extra move to cross). A Salvager on a wreck can scrap it for 25% of the unit's cost in funds, or repair itself or an adjacent vehicle by 3 HP with the parts. Gives Lastholm an economy that feeds on the fighting.

units.name: Broadcast Truck
units.mechanic: NEW MECHANIC, liberation: campaign only. Plays the old national radio over the Chorus signal: an assimilated enemy unit next to it with 3 HP or less at the start of your turn breaks free and joins your side (keeping its HP). Unarmed and fragile. Turns the story's liberation into something you do on the map, and makes weakening a unit better than finishing it.

units.name: Armoured Airship
units.mechanic: Slow (move 4) but very tough against ground fire: carries two infantry, and every carried unit heals 1 HP per turn on board. Fighters and flak tear it apart. A floating forward base rather than a quick shuttle.

units.name: Loitering Drone
units.mechanic: NEW MECHANIC, single use: it attacks by diving into the target, dealing heavy damage to anything on the ground or at sea, and is destroyed doing so (no counterattack against it). Can wait a turn in the air hidden (cloaked) before striking. Expensive per shot, cheap per tank.

units.name: Q-Ship
units.mechanic: NEW MECHANIC, false colours: to the enemy it looks like a neutral cargo ship that cannot be targeted, until it fires (then it shows its colours for good). Strong first shot against ships, weak afterwards. A trick for Adm. Rex of Tidehaven.

units.name: Coastal Battery
units.mechanic: Must be built on a tile next to the sea. A long naval gun with range 2 to 5 that fires only at ships and surfaced submarines, hitting as hard as a battleship. Makes a harbour a fortress; no use inland.

units.name: Barrage Balloon
units.mechanic: Unarmed. Aircraft cannot end a move on its tile or the four tiles next to it, and any aircraft that flies through them takes 1 damage on the cable. Cheap air denial that shapes where planes can go instead of shooting them down.

units.name: Tank Trap
units.mechanic: Dragon's teeth: wheeled and tracked vehicles cannot enter its tile, but infantry, hover craft and aircraft can, and infantry on it get the defence of a forest. The cheap half-wall: it stops the tanks and lets your soldiers through.

units.name: Watchtower
units.mechanic: Unarmed. In fog of war it sees 5 tiles over everything (forests and mountains included), and it reveals cloaked ground units within 2. A unit standing on it can see as far as the tower. Fragile: one tank shot brings it down.
